content.comment_body: I am considering purchasing a [product_name] (version_no) programmable controller but need to know if it can read text from an RS232 output, extract certain characters, and use them as input values for my application. Is this possible with the [product_name] (version_no)? My goal is to parse kW input and export data from my smart electric meter following the specifications detailed in [document] starting around page 6: [url]

No, this is not possible. The [product_name] (article_no) is limited to Ethernet TCP/IP communication using proprietary protocols. Beginning with another version ([version_no]), Modbus TCP/IP is also supported. Serial text parsing and manipulation for your use case cannot be achieved using this device.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to acquire and process textual data sent via RS232 from a smart meter, using a specific programmable controller ([product_name], version_no). Responses indicate that this device only handles data through Ethernet TCP/IP, with additional Modbus TCP/IP support in later versions, and does not support serial text parsing. This underscores a limitation in its capability to interface flexibly with devices using serial communication.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that the device should accept RS232 text input, support advanced string parsing, and enable integration with a variety of device interfaces.
